title: cmdshape YAML Filter
description: Structural authoring schema for cmdshape YAML filters. Runtime validation in Go remains authoritative for semantic constraints such as regex named captures, template variable references, and some mode-specific rules.

version.description: Schema version for the YAML filter format. Must be exactly 1.

filter.description: Canonical filter id. This usually matches the YAML filename and any mapping targets.

about.description: Optional human-readable note describing the filter's purpose or scope.

items.description: One flag token that consumes the next argv token when written in split form.

flags_consuming_next_arg.description: Tool-level flag tokens that consume the next argv token when cmdshape decides whether later tokens are real positional arguments. List split-form flags such as '-run' for '-run value'; attached forms such as '--format=json' are already self-contained and do not need listing. Each entry must begin with '-'.

cases.description: Ordered matching cases for this filter. At least one case is required. Runtime validation also requires each case id to be unique.

case.description: One rule branch selected by command shape. A case may normalize arguments, pass through unchanged, compress output, and emit a final summary.

id.description: Stable case identifier used for authoring and diagnostics. Must be non-empty and unique within the filter.

variables.description: Case-scoped variables for line-level counters and summaries. Runtime validation requires unique names, and case-level variables must not set regex_group.

when_arguments.description: Optional predicates for matching argv before this case applies. Runtime validation requires at least one predicate when the block is present.

normalize_command.description: Optional command normalization applied before execution. Runtime validation requires at least one mutation when the block is present.

passthrough.description: When true, cmdshape keeps the command output unchanged for this case. Invariant: passthrough cases must not also define compress_output.

compress_output.description: Optional output compaction rules for this case. Invariant: not allowed when passthrough is true.

finally.description: Optional text emitted after the case finishes.

variable.description: Declared variable used by counters, templates, and grouped output. Some invariants depend on where the variable is declared.

name.description: Variable name used in templates such as {{name}}. Runtime validation requires names to be unique within the enclosing variable list.

type.description: Variable storage type. Only number and string are supported.

initial_value.description: Optional initial value before any matches run. Stored as text even for number variables and interpreted by runtime code.

regex_group.description: Named regex capture to import into this variable. Runtime invariants: case-level variables must not set it; boundary groups may use it only with starts_with_regex; collect groups may use it only when the named capture exists in matches_regex; number variables must not set it.

default_value.description: Fallback value used when the selected regex capture is empty or missing.

string_array.description: List of literal argv tokens, flags, or substrings evaluated in order by the relevant predicate or mutation.

when_arguments.description: Argument predicates for selecting a case. Runtime validation requires at least one field in this block to be set.

first_is.description: Matches when the first argument equals this exact token.

first_in.description: Matches when the first argument equals any listed token.

have_any.description: Matches when argv contains at least one listed token anywhere.

lack_any.description: Matches when argv contains none of the listed tokens.

have_sequence.description: Matches when argv contains this exact ordered subsequence.

have_short_flag.description: Matches when at least one listed short flag is present.

not_have_short_flag.description: Matches when each listed short flag is absent.

have_all_short_flags.description: Matches when all listed short flags are present.

not_have_all_short_flags.description: Matches when the full listed short-flag set is not present together.

positionals_lack_any.description: Matches when positional arguments contain none of the listed tokens.

no_positionals.description: Matches when the command has no positional arguments.

command_mutation.description: Command normalization applied before execution. Runtime validation requires at least one mutation field in this block.

append_if_missing.description: Append these tokens only if they are not already present anywhere in argv.

append_if_no_positionals.description: Append these tokens only when the command has no positional arguments.

add_short_flags.description: Ensure these short flags are present, preserving native flag semantics handled by the runtime.

output_shape.description: Top-level output routing for compressed output. Invariants: define at least one scope, and never mix combined with stdout or stderr scopes.

oneOf.description: Compress the merged output stream as one ordered sequence.

combined.description: Rules applied to the combined stdout and stderr stream. Must not appear with stdout or stderr.

oneOf.description: Compress stdout, optionally with a separate stderr scope.

stderr.description: Optional rules applied only to stderr.

oneOf.description: Compress stderr, optionally with a separate stdout scope.

stdout.description: Optional rules applied only to stdout.

output_scope.description: Compression rules for one output stream. Runtime validation requires at least one of lines or groups.

lines.description: Line-oriented filtering and summarization for this scope.

groups.description: Optional grouping rules evaluated within this scope. Collect groups unlock max.groups_summary in the same scope.

output_lines.description: Line-level transformations. Replace, skip, and keep rules may coexist. Runtime validation enforces matcher exclusivity inside each rule.

replace.description: Line rewrite rules evaluated in order.

skip.description: Rules for lines to drop from the output.

keep.description: Rules for lines to force through even when other filters would normally reduce them.

max.description: Optional cap on the number of lines emitted from this scope.

max_rule.description: Line limit plus optional summary text emitted for omitted lines.

count.description: Maximum number of lines to emit before cmdshape starts summarizing. Must be positive.

print.description: Optional summary template printed when lines are omitted. Runtime invariant: may reference only {{value}}, plus {{groups_summary}} when groups_summary is configured.

groups_summary.description: Optional grouped summary appended to max.print. Runtime invariant: only valid when the same output scope contains at least one collect group.

max_groups_summary.description: Formatting rules for summarizing collect groups when max truncates output.

show.description: How many top groups to render before collapsing the remainder. Must be positive.

print.description: Template for one rendered group entry. Runtime invariant: may reference only {{key}} and {{count}}.

delimiter.description: Literal text inserted between rendered group entries. Runtime invariant: template variables are not allowed here.

prefix.description: Literal text prepended before the rendered group list. Runtime invariant: template variables are not allowed here.

suffix.description: Text appended after the rendered group list. Runtime invariant: may reference only {{remaining}}.

replace_rule.description: Replace matching lines with new text. Runtime invariant: set exactly one matcher field from regex, starts_with, contains, or ends_with.

regex.description: Regular expression matcher for the full line. Must be the only matcher field when used.

starts_with.description: Literal line-prefix matcher. Must be the only matcher field when used.

contains.description: Literal substring matcher. Must be the only matcher field when used.

ends_with.description: Literal line-suffix matcher. Must be the only matcher field when used.

to.description: Replacement text for a matched line. May be empty. In group lines, runtime validation checks template variables against declared group variables.

on_match.description: Variable updates performed when this rule matches. Runtime validation requires each action to reference a declared case variable.

skip_keep_rule.description: Predicate for skipping or keeping lines. Runtime invariant: set exactly one matcher field from regex, starts_with, contains, or ends_with.

regex.description: Regular expression matcher for the full line.

match_action.description: Counter update performed after a replace rule matches.

variable.description: Declared case variable to update. Runtime validation requires this name to exist in the enclosing case variables list.

increment.description: Signed delta applied to the target variable.

on_exit.description: Synthetic text emitted at a lifecycle boundary.

print.description: Text to emit. Must be non-empty. In group lifecycle stages, runtime validation checks template variables against declared group variables.

output_group.description: Line grouping rule. A group must be either boundary-based or collect-based, never both, and must define at least one lifecycle stage: initially, lines, or finally.

id.description: Stable group identifier used in diagnostics.

starts_with.description: Boundary-group opener matched by literal prefix. Invariant: boundary groups may set starts_with or starts_with_regex, but not both, and must not mix with collect fields.

starts_with_regex.description: Boundary-group opener matched by regex. String variables may bind named captures through regex_group when this is set.

matches_regex.description: Collect-group matcher for lines that should be aggregated. Invariant: collect groups require both matches_regex and group_by.

variables.description: Group-scoped variables available to group templates. Runtime validation requires unique names and enforces regex_group rules based on group mode.

group_by.description: Collect-group key template. Runtime invariant: may reference only variables declared in this group's variables list.

initially.description: Optional text emitted when the group starts. At least one of initially, lines, or finally is required for every group.

lines.description: Optional line-level rules applied within the group.

finally.description: Optional text emitted when the group ends. At least one of initially, lines, or finally is required for every group.
